# AAAA

AAAA is aimed at Chinese long-form reading: it sets Source Han Sans CN, a comfortable line width, and adjusted line height and spacing. Its styling covers blue-purple gradient H1 headings, rainbow-coloured outline levels, a palette shared by light and dark modes, code blocks tuned for FiraCode, and tables in a plain LaTeX-like style.

![AAAA screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/austinsuun/obsidian-AAAA/HEAD/screenshots/light.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "AAAA"
    author: "austinsuun"
    repo:   "austinsuun/obsidian-AAAA"
    slug:   "aaaa"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/aaaa"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/austinsuun/obsidian-AAAA"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/austinsuun/obsidian-AAAA/HEAD/screenshots/light.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Optimize Chinese reading with Source Han Sans CN, comfortable line width, and adjusted line height and spacing for long-form text. Style notes with blue-purple gradient H1s, rainbow outline levels, unified light/dark palettes, FiraCode-friendly code blocks, and clean LaTeX-style tables."
}
```
